loop.top3_series_pattern: seasonal_dominated with strong 52‑week seasonality and no clear trend; moderate predictability and unstable model ranking across windows.
loop.top3_why: The mean of the full pool (family=mean) shows the most stable per‑window performance (≈0.75 in all three windows) and matches the best validation score among the candidates.  The weighted inverse‑error strategy (A) is attractive but relies on a small number of windows to estimate weights, which can be noisy given the unstable ranking and correlated errors.  The median (B) is robust to outliers but its per‑window errors are highly variable, indicating that it is being pulled by a few poorly performing models in some windows.  The mean therefore offers the best balance of stability and performance for this series.
loop.top3_why_not: A: Although it has the lowest mean error, its weights are derived from a limited sample and may overfit to the validation windows; its per‑window errors are also slightly higher than the mean.  B: The median is robust but its per‑window errors vary widely (0.63–0.86), suggesting sensitivity to model outliers; this instability is undesirable for a series with unstable ranking.  Both A and B are therefore less reliable than the plain mean for this particular series.
